{{Quote|You can't be sneaking up on me like that. Nearly gave me a heart attack.|Meric|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Meric''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], he identified Imperial activity on the rooftops of several captured Republic factories. When the soldiers he dispatched to investigate did not return, Meric persuaded a fellow Republic citizen to storm the roofs of the factories and prevent Imperial war droids from detonating explosives that would have destroyed them.
